Consider yourself LUCKY!|[[Jaxe (Narrator)|Jaxe]] dialogue on Wave 8 ([[Rotfield]])}} }} __TOC__ ==Description== The '''Jaxe''' was the boss of the first night in the [[Solar Eclipse Event]]. It had significantly higher health than the enemies that appeared before, however it was also much slower. The '''Jaxe''' had one ability, where it would throw its axe at a tower, stunning any tower hit. It would also deal at least 60 damage to [[units]]. ==Appearance== The '''Jaxe''' had green skin and an orange pumpkin head with a scar on its left eye. It wore a black cape, grey chestplate, shoulder-pads and knee-pads. It also had black wrist-bands and orange arm-bands on both of its arms. It wielded a large axe to attack towers. ==Strategy== *Use high DPS towers with cheap costs, such as the [[Swarmer]], [[Pursuit]] and the [[Minigunner]] to defeat the '''Jaxe'''. *Because of its early wave debut, and the low amount of health that other enemies have, towers like the [[Ranger]] and [[Accelerator]] may not be feasible in this night. *Multiple level 3 [[Scout]]s can also fend off well against the '''Jaxe'''. *Multiple level 3 [[Crook Boss]]es can also defeat the '''Jaxe''' due to their high DPS and cheap price. *You can use the [[Commander]] and [[DJ Booth]] to boost the firerate and range of towers respectively. *Because of its size and immunities, towers that slow down enemies are very ineffective against the '''Jaxe'''. **The [[Electroshocker]] can only slow down the '''Jaxe''' instead of stunning it because of its [[Energy Immunity]]. It can also only slow it down for a shorter amount of time because of its size. *Spacing out your towers can minimize the amount of towers stunned by the ''Axe Throw''. **While the ''Axe Throw'' ability cannot directly target [[units]], it can still damage them. ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Icons}} SolarEclipseIcon.png|'''Jaxe''' on the game icon. {{GalleryHeader|Promotional Images}} NightIPI.jpg|'''Jaxe''' on a promotional image. {{GalleryHeader|Trailers}} Tower Defense Simulator- Solar Eclipse Trailer|'''Jaxe''' in the game trailer. {{GalleryHeader|Miscellaneous}} JaxeIconIG.png|'''Jaxe''' on its [[Index]] icon. }} ==Trivia== *The '''Jaxe''' had the third lowest health for a major boss in the entire game, only beaten by the [[Ripped Elf (Krampus Frosthold)|Ripped Elf]] and the [[Dummy Boss]]. *The '''Jaxe''' is the first narrator that is also an enemy. *The '''Jaxe's''' legs used the R6 rig, while the rest of its body used an R15 rig. *The '''Jaxe''' is based on the original [[Jaxe (Nightmare Carnival)|Jaxe]] from [[Halloween 2019 Event|Halloween 2019]]'s [[Nightmare Carnival]]. *The '''Jaxe''' had the shortest name of any major boss, at a mere 4 characters. *Upon defeat, the '''Jaxe's''' head would fall and roll for a short distance. **This head is later turned into a candy bucket that is used in the [[Candy Throw]] emote, as suggested by the emote's description. *The '''Jaxe's''' ''Axe Throw'' ability uses the same laugh as the [[Lord Sinister]]'s ''Sinister Taunt''. *A similar [[Enemies|enemy]] to the '''Jaxe,''' the [[Headless Jaxe]], could have been seen in [[Totality Tower]]. *The cape used by the '''Jaxe''' was the {{RLinkC|215748322|Guardian of the Night Cape}} accessory from the Roblox catalog. *The '''Jaxe''' was unintentionally added to the legacy [[Hidden Wave (Legacy)|Hidden Wave]] when it was added to [[Sandbox Mode]]. **This is because the '''Jaxe''' replaced the [[Nightmare Carnival]] [[Jaxe (Nightmare Carnival)|Jaxe]] as both of them shared the same name. ***A similar case happened with the [[Village of Despair]] [[Frost Hero (Village of Despair)|Frost Hero]], which was unintentionally replaced by the [[Outpost 32 (Frost Invasion)|Frost Invasion]] [[Frost Hero (Frost Invasion)|Frost Hero]] in the [[Overhaul v1.3|Frost Invasion]] update. ==Update History== *'''4
